entries.statement: Only workspace owners can change billing or cancel the subscription.
entries.rationale: Role model in the product brief; members may view plan details only.

entries.statement: Cancellation lives in its own section with a consequence review, separate from routine settings.
entries.rationale: Prevents accidental cancellation and makes the end-of-access date explicit.

entries.statement: Do not use a monthly/annual price toggle as the commitment control.
entries.rationale: The toggle looks like it changes billing before the user confirms; use a review step instead.

entries.statement: What happens when a workspace above the Free seat limit cancels?
entries.rationale: The product rule is unknown; do not invent a downgrade path or data-retention behavior.

entries.statement: Consider annual billing for the Pro plan later; no decision has been made.
